prereg: PREREG_CLIP_HOLDOUT_233.md (commit 8aaeea7, written and committed before this file existed)
verdict: NOT CONFIRMED. The pre-registered rule was: CONFIRMED only if the 95% bootstrap CI lower bound of (clip - canonical) > 0. The gain is -0.0285 with CI [-0.0427, -0.0142]: the lower bound is negative, and the point estimate is negative too.
what_happened: clip is much WORSE out of sample: r 0.1548 against 0.2380 for the canonical chain, a drop of 0.083. The in-fold +0.008 does not merely fail to replicate -- it reverses.
why_this_is_the_answer_not_a_bug_check: one extraction pipeline throughout (the 999-subject block), train on 728 benchmark subjects, test on 246 held-out subjects, covariates in-fold, 30 random training subsets. The design was fixed in the pre-registration before the numbers were seen.
interpretation: clipping removes variance that carries individual differences. Within the 753 the clipping and the KRR fit compensate for each other; on new subjects the removed variance is simply gone. This is the same shape as the motor-drop result, but larger and with the sign against the transform.

standing_of_clip_after_this.headline_use: do not use 0.7296 as a headline; clip is an in-fold effect that reverses out of sample

_INVALID_1119.verdict: INVALID EXECUTION — the pre-registered hypothesis was NOT tested.
reasons: 1. all six modality kernels were built from the same resting-state features: the loop is `for m in MODS: E = bpp.astype(...)` and never uses m, so the "canonical" arm is one resting-state feature set added six times, not the certified six-modality chain. The r 0.238 against CANON_HOLDOUT_233 D1 0.7721 on the same kind of split is the giveaway.
2. clip was applied to P (before the alpha re-weight), while the in-fold +0.0081 was measured on Pa/F (after alpha). Different transform.
3. no covariate regression, although the pre-registration requires age band + sex fitted on the training set.
4. training set was frac=0.6 (437 of 728 per seed), not all benchmark subjects in the block.
5. decision metric was absolute error only; the pre-registration asks for a bootstrap CI on the pooled r difference. The r difference has no CI in this file.
6. evaluated on 246 subjects rather than 233, because subjects without task FC were included.
_INVALID_1119.retraction: the claims "clip reverses out of sample (-0.083 r)" and "same shape as the motor-drop mechanism" are WITHDRAWN — both rested on this invalid run.
_INVALID_1119.clip_standing_now: in-fold +0.007~0.008, not significant under the exact NB t (p 0.12-0.15), out-of-sample UNTESTED.
_INVALID_1119.why_not_rerun: at 246 subjects the bootstrap half-width is ~0.018 (cf. the RELATIONAL holdout: +0.011 with CI [-0.006, +0.029]). An effect of +0.008 would almost certainly read "not confirmed" even if real, so a rerun adds a number and no information.
